sources.snippet: Qwen releases Qwen3-Coder-Next, an 80B MoE model (3B active parameters) with 256K context for fast agentic coding and local use. It is comparable to the performance of models with 10-20× more active parameters. It runs on 46GB RAM /VRAM/unified memory (85GB for 8-bit), is non-reasoning for ultra-quick code responses. The model excels at long-horizon reasoning, complex tool use, and recovery ...
